events.title: Netherfield has a tenant
events.note: Mrs. Bennet relays the news and presses for a visit.

events.title: The visit is revealed
events.note: Mr. Bennet reveals his earlier visit during the family conversation.

events.title: Bingley dances with Jane
events.note: Jane is the only partner Bingley asks for a second time.

events.title: Elizabeth overhears Darcy
events.note: Darcy declines the proposed introduction; Elizabeth tells the story to her friends.

events.title: The family returns home
events.note: Mrs. Bennet reports the evening to her husband.
